Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class OddThread implements Runnable {
	Thread thread;

	OddThread() {

		thread = new Thread(this);
		System.out.println("Odd thread");
		thread.start();
	}

	@Override
	public void run() {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i += 2) {
			System.out.println(i);
		}
	}
}

class EvenThread implements Runnable {
	Thread thread;

	EvenThread() {

		thread = new Thread(this);
		System.out.println("Even thread");
		thread.start();
	}

	@Override
	public void run() {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i += 2) {
			System.out.println(i);
		}
	}

}

public class Thread4 {
	public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
		EvenThread even = new EvenThread();
		OddThread odd = new OddThread();
//		odd.thread.join();
//		even.thread.join();

	}

}
